column1: # Every file under third_party/, and where it came from (plan.md STUDIO-10012).
# The rule this file exists to enforce: provenance, licence, version and reason are recorded
# *before* a dependency is added. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is where the reasons live and is meant to
# be read; this is the same facts in a shape a test can check, so that "everything vendored is
# accounted for" is a gate rather than a habit. ThirdPartyProvenanceTests.cpp walks this directory
# and fails on any file that is not listed here, and on any listed hash that no longer matches.
# sha256 of "-" means the file is this repository's own work, carries this repository's licence,
# and has no upstream to be verbatim against.
